## Paper Summary

## Key Points and Thoughts
Sampled hundreds of ciliate and testate amoeba
Studied both the environment of the samples and their holobiomes
Environment
extract total DNA
sequence all DNA
assemble genomes (MAGs)
identify organisms
built co-occurrence networks
Holobiome
isolate individual cells
whole genome amplification
sequence amplified DNA
separate sequences
predict symbiotic relationships
Broad Results:
Single protist cells contained bacterial endosymbionts
Protists co-occured with DNA viruses (found consistently)
Protist-bacteria-virus interactions were found (multipartite associations)
